analysis.analysis: The retention rate across all channels is 91.0%, with a churn rate of 9.0%. The number of retained customers is 1890. The highest retention rate is from Email at 94.00%, while the lowest is from Facebook at 87.00%. The churn rate for Facebook is notably high at 13.0%, indicating potential issues in retaining customers through this channel. The overall customer acquisition cost is approximately 3.37 per new customer, which suggests that while new customers are being acquired, the retention of existing customers is not as strong as it could be.

recommendations.title: Increase Budget for Email and TikTok Channels
recommendations.whats_happening: Email and TikTok channels have the highest retention rates but receive a lower budget allocation compared to their performance.
evidence: Email retention rate: 94.00% with 6.1% of budget
TikTok retention rate: 93.00% with 30.7% of budget

what_you_should_do.step: Reallocate budget to increase spend on Email and TikTok channels.
what_you_should_do.how: Shift funds from lower-performing channels like Facebook to Email and TikTok.
guardrails: Monitor performance post-reallocation to avoid negative impacts.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Increasing spend on high-performing channels can enhance retention rates and reduce churn, leading to more retained customers.

expected_impact.explanation: Higher investment in channels with proven retention success should boost overall retention rates.

dependency_or_risk: Budget reallocation may require approval from finance.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare retention rates and number of retained customers before and after budget change.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Retention rate increases by at least 2%.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider seasonality effects and attribution delays.

recommendations.title: Address High Churn on Facebook Channel
recommendations.whats_happening: Facebook has the lowest retention rate and highest churn rate, indicating issues in retaining customers.

what_you_should_do.step: Conduct a detailed analysis of Facebook audience targeting and engagement strategies.
what_you_should_do.how: Review current audience segments and engagement tactics to identify areas for improvement.
guardrails: Ensure alignment with overall brand strategy.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Improving retention on Facebook can significantly reduce churn and increase the number of retained customers.

expected_impact.explanation: Targeted improvements should reduce churn by addressing customer dissatisfaction.

dependency_or_risk: Requires collaboration with the social media team.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Monitor changes in churn rate and customer feedback post-implementation.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Churn rate decreases by at least 3%.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider external factors affecting Facebook engagement.

recommendations.title: Enhance Post-Click Experience on Facebook
recommendations.whats_happening: The post-click phase on Facebook is underperforming, contributing to low retention rates.
evidence: Facebook has the lowest retention rate at 87.00%

what_you_should_do.step: Optimize landing pages and post-click content for Facebook ads.
what_you_should_do.how: Ensure landing pages are relevant, fast-loading, and user-friendly.
guardrails: Test changes incrementally to measure impact.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Improving the user experience post-click can lead to higher retention and lower churn rates.

expected_impact.explanation: Enhanced user experience should lead to more repeat visits and purchases.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Track changes in bounce rate and retention rate after improvements.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Bounce rate decreases and retention rate increases.
measurement_plan.notes: Be aware of potential technical challenges.

recommendations.why_this_matters: SMS can be a cost-effective way to boost retention and reduce churn.

expected_impact.explanation: Personalized SMS campaigns can drive customer engagement and repeat purchases.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Monitor changes in retention rate and customer responses to SMS campaigns.
